We are reinstating our SAT/ACT requirement for future admissions cycles

Posted on 28 March 2022 by the dean of admissions.

Today we are announcing that we are reinstating our SAT or ACT requirement, starting in the next admissions cycle. For the four cycles before this one our standardized testing policy was test optional.

Why we are making this change

Our research found that standardized testing helps us identify applicants who will thrive here. Applicants should submit scores unless a waiver applies.
